description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing and configuring various network and protocol parameters in a software project related to IPv6, MAP-E, and other network services. It includes functions for setting up network interfaces, starting/stopping daemons, configuring DNS and DHCP servers, and managing HTTPS setup with SSL certificates.

methods.name: setupInterfaces
methods.description: Configures network interfaces, including VLAN setup, IPv6 address assignment, routing, and tunnel configuration based on the service type and parameters.

methods.name: setupDns
methods.description: Sets up DNS server configuration, including zone files for various services, and prepares the DNS environment.

methods.name: setupDhcpd6
methods.description: Configures and starts the DHCPv6 server with appropriate parameters and prefix settings.

methods.name: setupDhcpd4
methods.description: Configures and starts the DHCPv4 server with specific network parameters.

methods.name: setupHttps
methods.description: Prepares HTTPS environment, setting up SSL certificates, configuring web server files, and starting the web server.

methods.name: setupAutoupdates
methods.description: Configures auto-update files and directories, copying specified update files to the correct locations.

methods.name: setupHtDocs
methods.description: Copies web document files to the document root and sets permissions.

methods.name: setupPppoes
methods.description: Sets up the PPPoE server configuration and starts the PPPoE server daemon.

methods.name: setupFinMsg
methods.description: Displays final instructions or messages related to the setup process, such as instructions for server certificate installation.
